Fisheye View Studio Compact Portable Package
=============================================

Build date: Thu 08/27/2026 11:11:16.23
Architecture: Windows x64
ZIP limit: less than 100,000,000 bytes

Application:
  Fisheye View Studio.exe

Bundled FFmpeg:
  _internal\tools\ffmpeg.exe

ffprobe.exe is not bundled. The application reads media information
through ffmpeg.exe itself.

Python and PySide6/Qt are bundled by PyInstaller.
Python and FFmpeg do not need to be installed on the destination PC.
